research_note: Curated from primary pages, abstracts and project descriptions. Books, recordings and code were not fully read, watched or executed. No verified future conference match is included in this pass.

resources.title: The C to Rust Migration Book
resources.why: Covers mixed-language APIs, ownership across FFI and incremental migration exercises.
resources.caveat: Overview and contents checked; exercise solutions were not run.

resources.title: Foreign Function Interface — The Rustonomicon
resources.why: Explains calling conventions, callbacks and unsafe boundaries when Rust and C share data.

resources.title: C2Rust
resources.why: Shows automated C translation as a starting point for comparison with manual migration.
resources.caveat: The project states that translated output remains unsafe and needs further migration work.

resources.title: Rust and ThreadX
resources.why: Provides an embedded example of combining Rust with an existing C real-time operating system.
resources.caveat: Historical integration example; certification statements are tied to its publication date.
